# Gamezone.de — German contemporary review

- Original source: [Gamezone.de — German contemporary review](https://www.gamezone.de/Robin-Hood-Die-Legende-von-Sherwood-Spiel-30523/Tests/Robin-Hood-Die-Legende-von-Sherwood-im-Gamezone-Test-988941/)
- Publication: Gamezone.de
- Language: German
- Access: Original article unavailable; the supplied captures are Cloudflare challenge pages
- Checked: 2026-09-09

## Original text unavailable

The mapped HTML and TXT files contain only an access challenge, not the review. No article paragraphs, headings, score, verdict, comments, or other substantive source text can be faithfully converted. The challenge text has been removed from this transcription.

## Editorial research notes

These notes are retained as research metadata and are not original Gamezone.de article text.

- An earlier pass recorded the author as “GreenAcid” and the date as 2002-11-15; both remain unverified.
- A search-result snippet describes the review as presenting the game as evidence that 2D graphics remain viable and as a genuine real-time tactics game with forward-looking improvements that give the player more freedom than *Desperados*. The snippet does not provide an author credit or score.
- Wikipedia’s reception table lists “GameZone 8.5/10”, but its citation refers to the US site gamezone.com (Michael Lafferty, 11 November 2002), not Gamezone.de.

## Access record (2026-09-09)

- Direct download: HTTP 403, returning a Cloudflare “Just a moment…” challenge.
- WebFetch: HTTP 403.
- Wayback Machine: no capture of this URL; a CDX index query for `gamezone.de` URLs containing `Legende-von-Sherwood` returned nothing.
- The supplied `originals/reviews__gamezone-de.html` and `originals/reviews__gamezone-de.txt` both contain only the challenge response.
